content.intro: In this lesson, focus on where is tailwind css used? and connect it to the way Tailwind CSS generates and applies utility styles.
content.why_it_matters: Where Is Tailwind CSS Used? provides the mental model needed to decide what belongs in HTML, what belongs in CSS, and how Tailwind utilities affect the rendered interface.

content_blocks.title: Version and compatibility note
content_blocks.text: This course prioritizes Tailwind CSS v4. Confirm your installed version and use its matching official guide. Snippets using v3 directives or configuration are labelled as legacy and should not be mixed blindly with v4 syntax.
